core_change_summary.description: In alpha_factory_v1/core/interface/api_server.py, the limiter and metrics middleware objects are explicitly stored as attributes on app.state (e.g., app.state.limiter, app.state.metrics). The test in tests/test_api_server_static.py was updated to access these middleware objects via app.state instead of direct references, verifying reuse.
